dispositions.accepted_text: Use the author's proposed correction with an explicit unofficial reverse-engineering disclaimer; OriginalSize and DataSize are member fields and Offset is unused/reserved in the reviewed layout.

The reviewed reverse-engineered layout can represent unsigned 32-bit sizes for individual members, up to 4,294,967,295 as a field-width fact. It does not establish a usable maximum member size or a maximum total PBO size. No current authoritative DayZ source reviewed here defines a total-PBO ceiling; engine, tool, distribution, and Workshop limits remain separate questions.
dispositions.qualification: The local 2,165,383,988-byte failure report is an unresolved project-specific historical lead, not evidence of a universal limit.

dispositions.accepted_text: Describe Cprs as a format marker in an unofficial description and state only that the reviewed installed Addon Builder/FileBank help has no compression switch.

A mod-folder launch name, physical PBO filename, virtual prefix, and configuration-addon identity are different names. requiredAddons[] refers to CfgPatches class names and controls addon/configuration initialization dependencies. Do not claim one CfgPatches identity per PBO. CfgMods registers modules/inputs and virtual paths; its dependencies[] labels are not a substitute for requiredAddons[] or a physical-PBO dependency declaration.
dispositions.reason: A physical PBO and a configuration-addon identity are not guaranteed one-to-one; config syntax did not prove runtime resolution.

dispositions.accepted_text: Sharing a prefix is not itself a dependency mechanism or proof of an error. As a release policy, normalize virtual paths case-insensitively across all PBOs and fail on duplicate paths by default. Permit a duplicate only through a documented allowlist backed by a controlled runtime test; never rely on textual launch order to choose a winner.
dispositions.reason: Disjoint paths are a conservative project policy, not a proven universal engine requirement; runtime winner remains unknown.

dispositions.accepted_text: Use isolated source/temp/output directories, validated tool paths, log inspection, exact output discovery, manifest rename, independent prefix/member inspection, collision scanning, final-byte hashing/signing, stdout-aware checks, and durable receipts. Do not treat exit zero or DSCheckSignatures as an end-to-end PBO/signature pairing proof.

dispositions.accepted_text: Document -mod and -serverMod at mod-folder/subfolder granularity; do not imply per-PBO selective server-only routing within one shared package.

CfgMods.inputs and module files[] entries name mounted virtual paths, not paths relative to the physical PBO root. If one archive's configuration names a path supplied by another archive, validate that cross-PBO arrangement in the packaged runtime instead of presenting it as proven by syntax.
Launch arguments make mod folders available; CfgPatches.requiredAddons[] declares addon/configuration initialization dependencies. Textual -mod order is not a substitute for requiredAddons[].
dispositions.qualification: Do not generalize this to every possible command-line-order effect.

dispositions.accepted_text: Sign final PBO bytes; distribute only the public key; reuse an uncompromised available key across ordinary updates; rotate after compromise, private-key loss/unavailability, or intentional trust reset. Signature v3 default in DSSignFile is unrelated to verifySignatures=2. Treat DSCheckSignatures only as a stdout-interpreted signature/key check, not PBO-byte pairing proof, and use controlled server joins for enforcement.
dispositions.runtime_gate: verifySignatures=2 matrix and serverMod-only signature behavior.

experiment.scope: isolated config parse, pack, inspect, key creation, sign, and static signature check; no game launch
results: Addon Builder without a correct toolsDirectory logged fatal missing-tool errors, returned exit code 0, and emitted no PBO.
With the installed toolsDirectory it emitted ComponentSource.pbo using the source-directory name; BankRev showed the requested prefix.
CfgConvert parsed the proposed Core and Scripts config fragments successfully; this proves syntax only.
DSSignFile did not modify the signed PBO and generated a bisign.
DSCheckSignatures printed OK for an old bisign beside a newly rebuilt, byte-different PBO and returned zero.
DSCheckSignatures printed Key not found for an empty keys directory but returned zero; an orphan bisign also returned zero without useful output.
experiment.conclusion: Exit code alone is not a release assertion, and this DSCheck invocation is not an end-to-end PBO/signature pairing test.
